blocks.text:
LIST OF THE COUNCIL OF MINISTER SHOWN - IN
AT 10.45 A.M. ON MONDAY, 14 JANUARY, 1930,
IN THE RAGHATRAJATI BHAVAN.

blocks.html:
1.Sardar Indira Gandhi...Prime Minister/All Ministries/Departments not specified below.
2.Shri Shriram Singh...Minister of Agriculture.
3.Shri C. Shankarman...Minister of Education.
4.Shri A.R. Gauri Laxman Chandravati...Minister of Energy and Irrigation
5.Shri P.V. Narasimha Rao...Minister of External Affairs
6.Shri B. Venkatachalam...Minister of Finance.
7.Shri V.P. Sathe...Minister of Information and Broadcasting.
8.Giani Zail Singh...Minister of Home Affairs
9.Shri Shiv Shankar...Minister of Law, Justice and Company Affairs.
10.Shri Dineshchandra Tripathi...Minister of Railways
11.Shri A.P. Sharma...Minister of Shipping and Transport
12.Shri J.B. Patnaik...Minister of Tourism and Civil Aviation.
13.Shri P.C. Sethi...Minister of Works and Housing
14.Shri Bhishma Narain Singh...Minister of Parliamentary Affairs.
15.Shri Pranab Mukherjee...Minister of Overseas.

1.Shri R.V. Sreenivasa Iyer...Minister of State in the Ministry of Agriculture.
2.Shri Jagannath Pandit...Minister of State in the Ministry of Finance.
3.Shri Nihar Ranjan Das...Minister of State in the Ministry of Health.
4.Shri P. Venkateswaraiah...Minister of State in the Ministry of Affairs.
5.Shri Yogendra Narkar...Minister of State in the Ministry of Home Affairs.

7.Shri Kartik Orion...Minister of State in the Ministry of Tourism and Civil Aviation.
